Rescale a series to match the mean and variance of another series

Source: R/rescale_to_match.R
rescale_to_match.Rd

Applies the linear transformation to y that matches the mean and the standard deviation of x on their overlapping (jointly observed) sample. Useful to compare measures of the same shock that are expressed in different units, for example a predicted shock and a proxy.

Usage

rescale_to_match(x, y)

Arguments

x

Numeric vector. Reference series (mean and variance target).

y

Numeric vector of the same length as x. Series to rescale.

Value

Numeric vector of the same length as y: a + b * y, with a and b chosen such that the result has the mean and standard deviation of x on the overlapping sample. Missing values of y remain missing.

Examples

set.seed(1)
x <- rnorm(50, mean = 2, sd = 3)
y <- 0.1 * x + rnorm(50, sd = 0.1)
y2 <- rescale_to_match(x, y)
c(mean(y2), sd(y2))
#> [1] 2.301345 2.494182
